summary: Modified session-operations.ts to call navigateTree on the first user entry when entryId is null, updated a comment in SessionTreeScreen.svelte about re-running prompts, and extracted tree rendering into a new SessionTreeList.svelte component. Also extracted an appendMessageToTree helper into fake-client/tree.ts and refactored prompt-stream.ts to use it, after which prettier formatting and line-length checks passed.
decisions: When entryId is null and a first user entry exists, call session.navigateTree(firstUserEntry.id) instead of manager.resetLeaf(), so re-running a prompt forks at the user message rather than resetting the leaf.
Extract the inline tree list rendering from SessionTreeScreen.svelte into a new SessionTreeList.svelte component to shrink the screen file below the 300-line limit.
Extract the message-to-tree append logic from prompt-stream.ts into a shared appendMessageToTree helper in fake-client/tree.ts to reduce duplication and file size.
errors: Initial multi-edit attempt on SessionTreeScreen.svelte failed because the third edit's oldText did not match exactly; resolved by splitting into a separate read and a targeted single edit.

check:loc failed initially because prompt-stream.ts was 307 lines and SessionTreeScreen.svelte was 304 lines (exceeding 300-line limit); resolved after refactoring into SessionTreeList.svelte and tree.ts helper.
